name: Introduction and overview — F-105 Thunderchief — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — F-105 Thunderchief
description: Introduction and overview of the F-105 Thunderchief: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The F-105 Thunderchief is a single-engine supersonic fighter-bomber built by Republic, entering service in 1958. Designed for nuclear strike, it became the workhorse of the Rolling Thunder bombing campaign over Vietnam, flying the majority of strike missions. 833 were built; the two-seat F-105G Wild Weasel hunted SAMs. Baseline facts: Supersonic fighter-bomber; service from 1958; 833 built by Republic; Vietnam strike workhorse..
how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; the engine provides thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.
